Thanks. Here is what happens next.

A local roofing company has your name, number, city and what you need. It will call you to arrange a look at the roof.

  • Ask whether there is a charge for the visit before it is booked; many roofers inspect at no charge, but policies differ.
  • Ask for photos of anything the roofer finds and a written, itemized estimate.
  • You are free to get other quotes before deciding.

Questions Houston homeowners ask

When will the roofing company call?

That depends on the company and on the weather; after a big storm every roofer in the region is busy. If you have not heard back and the problem is getting worse, call the line again at any hour.

What should I do while I wait?

Stay off the roof. Move belongings away from any drip, put a bucket and towels under it, and photograph the damage from the ground and inside the house. If a storm caused it, call your insurer. The storm damage steps guide covers the rest.

How do I get ready for the roofer's visit?

Have your photos, your insurance policy and any claim number handy, and clear a path to the attic hatch so the roofer can look inside. Write down when the problem started. The roof inspection page explains what a thorough visit covers.
